source_name: ФГВФО — Надходження до банків, що ліквідуються (receipts and creditor-claim settlement)
why_relevant: Periodically refreshed article series reporting cash inflows into banks in liquidation and amounts directed to satisfying creditor claims (e.g. UAH 2,463.4m received and UAH 2.96bn paid to creditors in H1 2026, of which UAH 2,078.9m from asset realisation). The closest thing to a P&L for the failed-bank estate.

source_name: Zakon Rada — Law On Payment Services and implementing regulations
why_relevant: Statutory basis for the licensing categories (платіжна установа, установа електронних грошей, філія іноземної платіжної установи) and for their statutory reporting. Needed to reason about which disclosures are mandatory versus voluntary.

source_name: Diia.Business news channel on register/open-data policy changes
why_relevant: Government business portal that announces changes to register accessibility (e.g. the restoration of ЄДР open data and which categories remain closed). Essential meta-source for knowing when a collection pipeline's upstream availability changes.

source_name: Diia Center library — procurement approval rules (center.diia.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Documents the approval regime for informatization procurements (including sub-500k UAH) effective from 01.10.2024 — needed to understand which payment-IT purchases are visible in ProZorro and which are approved through a separate Mintsyfra gate.

source_name: NBU Banking Sector Review / Огляд банківського сектору
why_relevant: Quarterly NBU review of banking-sector funding, lending, income and profitability — the closest thing to a sector-wide quarterly earnings commentary in Ukraine.

source_name: NBU publication of the Memorandum on Economic and Financial Policies (Ukrainian translation)
why_relevant: The NBU and MoF publish Ukrainian translations of the Letter of Intent / Memorandum про економічну та фінансову політику agreed with the IMF. These carry banking-sector commitments (state bank strategy, NPL resolution, DGF/Фонд гарантування вкладів reform) in the local terminology used by Ukrainian regulators and media — essential for local-language matching.

source_name: NBU Annual Reports PDF series (admin_uploads direct-file mirror)
why_relevant: NBU annual reports are served as flat, predictably-named PDFs under /admin_uploads/article/, which makes them trivially mirrorable offline and trivially recoverable from Wayback when the CMS reshuffles its navigation. The sector-level baseline document set (incl. 2021 pre-invasion) for this cell's offline-PDF mirror.

source_name: Положення про розкриття інформації емітентами цінних паперів (z1307-23) та Положення про Державний реєстр випусків цінних паперів (z0772-24) — zakon.rada.gov.ua
why_relevant: The binding rulebook that fixes what issuers (including banks and providers of security for bonds) must disclose, in what XML form, on what deadlines, and via which venue (Commission database vs. an authorised regulated-information publisher). It is the schema authority for any parser built on these filings.

source_name: NBU legal acts repository (admin_uploads/law) — payment services regulations
why_relevant: Where the NBU posts the resolutions that define reporting duties, licence conditions and register content for payment institutions and e-money issuers. Determines what these firms are legally obliged to disclose.

source_name: NBU consolidated financial statements (own accounts) / Консолідована фінансова звітність НБУ
why_relevant: The central bank's own audited IFRS consolidated statements, including profit distribution to the state budget — relevant to fiscal-monetary linkage and to benchmarking sector accounting practice.

source_name: NBU Monetary and Supervisory Statistics methodology note (M_AND_S)
why_relevant: Methodological description of how NBU builds monetary and supervisory statistics, including the 'Основні показники діяльності банків України' table. Needed to interpret series breaks and definitions correctly.

source_name: НКЦПФР — «Затвердження проспекту цінних паперів» / адміністративні послуги з реєстрації випусків
why_relevant: Defines the procedural pipeline by which a bank bond prospectus becomes public: what is filed, in what form, and where the resulting act is published. Necessary to know so the collection pipeline targets the right artefact types and timing.

source_name: NBU Annual Report / Річний звіт Національного банку України
why_relevant: Annual NBU report (published since 1994) summarising macrofinancial and banking-sector developments, supervisory actions and sector aggregates — a canonical annual-report node for the cell.

source_name: SMIDA XML Report — схеми XML файлів звітності емітентів (Наказ №35 від 20.03.2024)
why_relevant: Machine-readable schemas and the 'склад інформації' definitions for annual/interim issuer reports and for special information. These are the field dictionaries needed to parse the filings for banks — e.g. which tags carry capital, results, governance and related-party data.

source_name: Unified Financial Reporting System rules for banks (NBU taxonomy announcement)
why_relevant: NBU rules for compiling bank financial statements under the IFRS taxonomy within Ukraine's unified Financial Reporting System (Єдина СФЗ) — governs the machine-readable format in which bank disclosures will be published, i.e. the future ingestion format.

source_name: arc.nssmc.gov.ua — архівна версія сайту НКЦПФР (SMIDA description, historical pages)
why_relevant: The regulator's archived website preserves older descriptions of the disclosure infrastructure and prior URL structures — useful for resolving link rot and for reconstructing how the disclosure system was organised before the 2021 migration.

source_name: УАФІК — Каталог фінтех-компаній України (annual fintech catalogue/research)
why_relevant: The flagship annual UAFIC study: a full catalogue of Ukrainian fintech companies plus survey-based market statistics (2025 edition surveyed ~150 market participants; produced with NBU, Ministry of Digital Transformation, IFC, SECO, GGF, Ukrainian Startup Fund). It is simultaneously a company roster and a market-sizing document — the highest-value single artefact in this cell.

source_name: Рахункова палата України — audits and analyses of the Deposit Guarantee Fund
why_relevant: Ukraine's supreme audit institution independently audits DGF activity, the use of Fund resources and the realisation of transferred property — including the risk of non-repayment of UAH 62.5bn of Fund debt to the Ministry of Finance. It supplies critical, non-self-reported assessment of the DGF's liquidation performance and recovery rates, plus follow-up 'information notices' tracking whether the DGF implemented recommendations.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — аналітичні звіти (Матриця/Дайджест платіжного шахрайства)
why_relevant: ЄМА publishes recurring sector-aggregate analytics on payment fraud, card volumes and open banking/SCA readiness — a rare non-regulator aggregate view of the UA payments market, useful as baseline market sizing and risk context.

source_name: «Правила розкриття інформації АТ «БАНК КРЕДИТ ДНІПРО» (disclosure policy PDF)
why_relevant: A bank's own disclosure rulebook enumerates exactly what it must publish, where, and on what cadence — an excellent template for building a checklist of expected artefacts across all Ukrainian private banks.

source_name: Minfin.com.ua — banking-sector results articles
why_relevant: Narrative write-ups summarising full-year and quarterly banking sector outcomes ('лідери прибутків та аутсайдери'), i.e. profit leaders/losers digests of NBU data useful for spotting which results the market treats as material.

source_name: Bank-hosted IFRS annual reports containing the independent auditor's report (Звіт незалежного аудитора)
why_relevant: The terminal artefact this cell validates: each bank publishes its IFRS statements with the signed independent auditor's report, naming the firm, the key partner, the opinion and key audit matters. Gives the ground-truth auditor→bank→year triple used to check register and transparency-report claims.

source_name: World Bank — Note on the Strategic Development of an Enhanced Bank Resolution Framework for Ukraine
why_relevant: IFI diagnostic of the Ukrainian bank resolution framework against the EU acquis (BRRD/DGSD). Explains the institutional mechanics behind DGF disclosures and flags where the regime is expected to change under EU accession — context that shapes what future disclosure will look like.

source_name: PrivatBank Integrated Report (annual, EN/UK PDF series)
why_relevant: Full IR-grade integrated annual report (strategy, digital channels, cards/acquiring volumes, ESG, risk) — richest single narrative document on the Ukrainian retail-payments leader; 2025 edition published May 2026.

source_name: Bank Vostok banking group consolidated IFRS statements (incl. АТ «ВЕРМОНТ»)
why_relevant: Group-level consolidated statements reveal the non-bank financial companies sitting alongside the bank — useful for mapping payments/fintech subsidiaries not visible in solo bank reporting.

entity_name: Academic / trade analyses of the Big Four in the Ukrainian audit market
source_name: Academic / trade analyses of the Big Four in the Ukrainian audit market
why_relevant: Peer-reviewed analysis of Big Four financial performance and market share in Ukraine, plus the FAAF monograph on ISA-compliant audit reports in Ukrainian practice. Useful for interpreting concentration, fee levels and reporting-quality norms behind the raw register data.

source_name: Center for Financial Stability — mirrored NBU Financial Stability/Annual report PDFs
why_relevant: Concrete example of a third-party OFFLINE PDF MIRROR: a US think tank hosting an NBU 2014 annual report copy. Third-party mirrors of central-bank reports are exactly the fallback this cell exists to catalogue, since they are unaffected by .ua hosting disruption.

source_name: Grant Thornton Ukraine — Звіт про прозорість (Art.37 series)
why_relevant: Non-Big-Four but PIE-eligible network firm with a clean, dated transparency-report series (2022, 2023, 2024). Covers the mid-tier of Ukrainian bank auditing that the Big Four series misses.

source_name: Investing.com earnings-call transcripts (ProCredit Holding)
why_relevant: Free full transcripts of ProCredit Holding calls in which Ukraine performance and default rates are discussed explicitly. A practical substitute where the issuer does not publish a written transcript.

source_name: Kinstellar client briefing — New Payment Services Law (UA)
why_relevant: Law-firm analysis mapping the new licence categories (payment institution, e-money institution, branch of a foreign payment institution) and the register/licensing mechanics — a fast orientation layer over dense regulation, and a pointer to further legal-sector commentary.

source_name: M.E.Doc accountants' blog — NBU payment system registration procedure explainers
why_relevant: Compliance-practitioner explainers that flag changes in registration and reporting procedure quickly and in plain Ukrainian; an early-warning layer on new filing duties for payment providers.

source_name: RBI annual financial report PDF (example: 2022 full annual financial report)
why_relevant: Concrete example of the RBI annual financial report artefact that contains the segment note with Ukraine figures; useful as a format/anchor document for building a parser, and confirms these PDFs are mirrored on secondary Raiffeisen domains.

source_name: Ukrainian Bar Association digital blog — payment systems commentary
why_relevant: Practitioner commentary on how payment systems are structured and supervised in Ukraine; useful for glossary building and for identifying which obligations bind non-bank providers.
